newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says full-year inflation target attainable.
newsitem.headline: Manila says full-year inflation target attainable.

text.p: Philippine Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson said on Monday that the government's inflation target for the year of six to seven percent was easily attainable.
Singson issued the statement after the National Statistics Office reported a slowdown in April inflation to 4.6 percent from 4.8 percent in March.
The inflation rate is lower than the 5.9 percent set under an International Monetary Fund (IMF) programme.
"(The slowdown) indicates a more solid basis for expecting more stable inflation in the ensuing months," Singson said.
"Achieving the whole year target of 6.0 to 7.0 percent is not going to be a difficult task," he added.
He said base money and reserve money levels were kept substantially lower than the ceilings set by the IMF.
